annotations.title: Load vet pack — authority + BASICs + broker + OFAC name

description: Load vet pack — authority + BASICs + broker + OFAC name. One call before you tender: FMCSA authority and SMS BASICs for the carrier (USDOT or MC), FMCSA broker authority for the broker on the load (broker_mc), plus an OFAC name screen when you pass a legal name. Verdict is TENDER, HOLD or REJECT from those public fields only — no invented fraud score. Cites FMCSA QCMobile and OFAC as_of. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

broker_mc.description: broker MC/docket number — runs the FMCSA broker-authority check (optional)

dot.description: carrier USDOT number (optional; give dot, mc or broker_mc)

mc.description: carrier MC/docket number (optional; give dot, mc or broker_mc)
